title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 16: Yahweh who directs steps, pride before destruction, and pleasant words.

questions.text: The plans of the heart belong to man, but what is from Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:1 says the plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

questions.text: What does this chapter say will happen if you commit your deeds to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:3 says commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

answers.text: Your house will be filled with treasure

questions.text: A man's heart plans his course, but who directs his steps?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:9 says a man's heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

questions.text: According to this chapter, getting wisdom is much better than getting what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:16 says how much better it is to get wisdom than gold, and to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

questions.text: What goes before destruction, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:18 says pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

questions.text: What are pleasant words compared to in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:24 says pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

questions.text: Where does the way that seems right to a man lead in the end?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:25 says there is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

questions.text: According to this chapter, what does a whisperer do?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:28 says a perverse man stirs up strife, and a whisperer separates close friends.

questions.text: What does this chapter call gray hair?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:31 says gray hair is a crown of glory, attained by a life of righteousness.

questions.text: The lot is cast into the lap, but where is its every decision from?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:33 says the lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.

answers.text: From the one who casts it
